title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Do you have anything going on? Going on MLB in a half hour, just making sure
We have talked to agents and reached out to GM’s but nothing yet. Sending in our protection list now. Other than that nothing
I think things may pick up after Thanksgiving. And leading into The winter meetings.
Sticking to our plan. Nothing fancy. We know it’s not popular but I know baseball people know it’s the right way.
At least we did not and do not give any bologna to our fans.
I’m just covering my bases in case something was happening
Don’t want to go on MLB and look like I don’t have my finger on the pulse
Here is a little News. You did not here it from me. Donny Kelly offered big League job with the Astros
Do you think he’s going to take it
I would, probably. That’s one step from the dugout, if that’s what he wants
